## main

[[ESP-IDF]] require `main` component in a project:

```
main/
	CMakeLists.txt
	main.cpp
	main.hpp
```

### `main/CMakeLists.txt`

```
idf_component_register(SRC_DIRS "." INCLUDE_DIRS ".")
```

## sdkconfig


```sh
idf.py menuconfig
```
